how_to_apply: Visit SBI's official careers website: sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
Scroll down and click on the advertisement for "Special Recruitment Drive for Junior Associates 2026," Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16.
Download and carefully read the detailed advertisement before applying.

Register online and fill in the application form with correct personal, educational, and category details. Not more than one application should be submitted; in case of multiple applications, only the last valid one will be retained.
Scan and upload your photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration, as per the specifications in the official notification's Annexure-II.
Pay the requisite application fee (OBC candidates only) through debit card, credit card, or internet banking.

Review your application carefully before final submission - no corrections are allowed after submission. Take a printout of the system-generated application form for your records (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).
Complete registration and fee payment before 27.08.2026.

For queries related to the application form, fee payment, or call letters, candidates can call 022-22820427 (11:00 AM to 5:00 PM on Bank working days) or raise a query at cgrs.ibps.in, mentioning "Special Recruitment drive for Junior Associates 2026" in the subject line.
important_instructions: Candidates can apply for vacancies of only one State/UT and can appear for the test only once under this recruitment project. Candidates must be proficient in the specified local language of the State/UT applied for; a local language test will be conducted after qualifying the Main Exam but before joining, for those who haven't studied that language in Class 10 or 12. Candidates must bring one photo ID proof, the authenticated call letters, and two extra photographs to the exam; failure to do so may result in disqualification from appearing. Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, calculators, or any communication/electronic devices are strictly not allowed inside the examination premises. Bank may conduct biometric (thumb impression/IRIS) verification at various stages; candidates should avoid mehandi, ink, or chemicals on their hands. Using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the exam hall, or any irregular means in connection with candidature can lead to disqualification, debarment from future SBI exams, and criminal prosecution. The newly appointed Junior Associates will be on probation for a minimum of 6 months and must complete prescribed e-lessons to get confirmed; probation may be extended if performance does not meet the Bank's expectations. The new recruits must be prepared for outdoor travelling, customer calls, cross-selling of products, and flexible working hours/shifts as required for the role. SBI does not endorse any external coaching platform, consultancy, or individual claiming to offer guaranteed selection or insider guidance; candidates must rely solely on SBI's official career portal. The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage, and its decisions on all matters relating to eligibility, tests, and selection are final and binding.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SBI has notified 1538 backlog vacancies across 21 states/UTs, reserved for SC, ST, and OBC candidates only. Candidates can apply for vacancies in only one State/UT, and merit lists will be drawn State-wise and category-wise. Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in that State's specified local language, mentioned against each row below. $ Candidates applying for Maharashtra (Maharashtra Circle/Mumbai Metro Circle) or Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow Circle) should verify operational areas via SBI's Branch Locator on its official website. Vacancy for the entire Uttar Pradesh state is under Lucknow Circle only. Vacancies are provisional and may vary based on the Bank's actual requirement. There is no provision for Inter-Circle or Inter-State transfer for Junior Associates, except Intra-State transfer between Delhi Circle and Lucknow Circle (within Uttar Pradesh) and between Mumbai Metro Circle and Maharashtra Circle (within Maharashtra), subject to the Bank's extant guidelines. PwBD and Ex-servicemen/Disabled ex-servicemen candidates can apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC), as there is no separate PwBD vacancy column in this drive.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government. Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed by 31.12.2026, if provisionally selected. Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate), after completing at least 15 years of service, are also eligible. Candidates currently working in SBI's Clerical cadre. Candidates previously employed in SBI who resigned while in the clerical cadre. Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude. OBC candidates falling under the "Creamy Layer." The post is identified as suitable for candidates with Blindness/Low Vision, Deafness/Hard of Hearing, specified locomotor disabilities (One/Both Arms or Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy, Spinal Deformity/Injury without associated neurological dysfunction), Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities involving the above. PwBD candidates apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC) as there is no horizontal PwBD reservation in this drive; a valid Disability Certificate on the prescribed format, dated on or before the last date of registration, is required to avail concessions such as scribe facility and compensatory time. Candidates must meet the definition of Ex-Serviceman as per Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 36034/5/85/Estt(SCT) dated 27th October 1986 (as amended). Disabled Ex-Servicemen, dependents of servicemen killed in action, and Territorial Army Personnel (w.e.f. 15.11.1986) are covered under specific conditions detailed in the official notification, including submission of the applicable Proforma (A, B, C, or D) as relevant to their service status.

content_sections.heading: SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be not below 20 years and not above 28 years as on 01.04.2026 - i.e., born not earlier than 02.04.1998 and not later than 01.04.2006 (both days inclusive). Cumulative age relaxation is not available either within the above categories or in combination with any other item. No change in category is permitted after registration of the online application. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

faq.question: Q1. What is SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Special Recruitment Drive (Advt. No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16) by State Bank of India to fill 1538 backlog vacancies for Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales), reserved exclusively for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q2. Is this recruitment open to General category candidates?
faq.answer: No. This is a Special Recruitment Drive against SC/ST/OBC backlog vacancies only; General/UR and EWS candidates are not eligible under this specific advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1538 total vacancies: SC (207), ST (1219), and OBC (112), spread across 21 states/UTs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration and fee payment window closes on 27.08.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for SBI Junior Associate posts?
faq.answer: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (or equivalent), as on 31.12.2026. Final-year students can apply provisionally.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years as on 01.04.2026, with relaxation of 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST, plus further relaxation for PwBD, Ex-servicemen, and specified categories of women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS candidates. OBC candidates must pay ₹750/- (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for SBI Junior Associate (Clerk)?
faq.answer: The starting basic pay is ₹26,730/- per month, with total starting emoluments of approximately ₹46,000/- per month at a metro location like Mumbai, inclusive of DA and other allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves an online Preliminary Examination (100 marks), a Main Examination (200 marks), and a Local Language Proficiency Test for candidates who haven't studied the applied State's local language in Class 10 or 12.

faq.question: Q10. When is the SBI Clerk exam 2026?
faq.answer: The Preliminary Examination is tentatively scheduled for September 2026, and the Main Examination for October/November 2026.
